text.style: font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243e3b

g.text: What changes from page to screen?

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Each card follows one shared topic across all seven stories. Circle = book; triangle = film.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Within each story, both averages use the same eligible characters, weighted by their modeled word counts.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Topic titles are interpretations of the existing eight-topic LDA. Numbers 1–7 indicate story installment.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Matched character coverage can vary by story; this is not a same-scene comparison. Exact coverage: series_topics.csv.
